review_scope: Personally inspected all 23 original 1280x720 PNGs and review_01.jpg through review_04.jpg comparing current main versus candidate. Technical review of visible physical surface presence, material separation, obvious UV/stretch/missing texture regressions and framing limitations. No new gross visible physical surface regression identified; dark/occluded views and changed wall mottling are explicitly retained below. Does not imply player testing, artistic acceptance, native-pixel optical acceptance, all-angle visibility, text readability, motion, physics, or gameplay/contact qualification. Automated surface inventory remains separate authority.
